notes.significance_method: Two-sided binomial test (hand-computed, p=0.5 null hypothesis) on decisive games only (ties excluded). Rivalries with fewer than 3 decisive games are flagged as 'sample too small' rather than given a potentially misleading p-value.
notes.network_method: This league's rivalry graph is a COMPLETE graph - all 105 of 105 possible manager pairs have played each other. This makes betweenness/degree centrality structurally meaningless (there's no 'bridging' role to measure when everyone already has a direct connection to everyone else), so those were deliberately NOT computed. The one genuinely meaningful signal for a complete weighted graph is total accumulated games across all of a manager's rivalries combined - who has the deepest cumulative head-to-head history, reflecting both tenure and matchup frequency.
